SAVE THE DATE

It started simply. No big moment, no grand plan, just two people meeting, talking, and somehow not wanting the conversation to end.

What felt like an ordinary day after work slowly became something a little more special, without us even realising it.

There wasn’t a single moment where everything suddenly made sense. “You and me” slowly became “us.” It just felt right, like we belonged to each other.

The best part isn’t how our story began, but everything we’ve built since. Today, we’re grateful for the little moments, the memories, and the beautiful life we get to share.

Shima & Mohammad
